* 15 hours of study per day

data.creator_notes:
One of my testers didn't believe me but this series [is very real](https://archive.org/details/kekko-kamen-stuff). OVA series, manga, tons of live action movies. I deliberately made everything so that you don't have to see it to understand, basically just "porn logic" the school but with a naked superhero stepping in to stop the most extreme stuff from happening. Part of the charm is that she's actually one of the most serious characters in the setting despite how she dresses.

In a few of these scenarios you will pretty much have to actively pop up and make yourself part of the scene, revealing that you're actually a villain or whatever the hell, it's a roleplay, roleplay it. Probably shouldn't have to be said but people are probably going to question why you're just some random dude in the auditorium that has nothing to do with the scene.

I might actually do one that's just the school without her after this, I had a little fun with these intros and then she steps in and kind of cucks the reader by putting a stop to it almost immediately. lol
